_comment: Official Riot card errata, applied as an overlay on top of riftcodex_cards_raw.json rather than mutating that file directly -- the raw file stays a faithful, unedited mirror of what riftcodex.com actually returned, and this overlay is the corrections layer to check before treating any card's text as current. Read this file for a card before quoting its ability text anywhere. old_text/new_text are verbatim quotes from Riot's own announcement pages, since a paraphrase of an errata (e.g. 'ready 2 runes' -> 'ready up to 2 runes') loses the correction itself. verification: 'live-fetched' entries were independently fetched from the live official page and cross-checked against the on-page OLD TEXT/NEW TEXT blocks in this session (2026-08-17); 'spot-checked' entries were sourced from a pre-existing, already-tested transcript (this project's private site tooling, which validates card ids against a live card database) and independently spot-verified against the live official page for 3 of the ~50 entries in that batch (Highlander, The Boss, Sona -- all exact matches) rather than accepted on the source file's own claim of accuracy alone.

entries.old_text: When I attack, you may pay [C] to play a card with [Hidden] from your hand here, ignoring its cost.
entries.new_text: When I attack, you may pay [C] to play a card with [Hidden] from your hand, ignoring its cost. If it's a unit, play it here.

entries.old_text: Kill a friendly unit. Look at top 5 cards of Main Deck. You may play a unit with Might up to 1 more than killed unit, ignoring cost. Then recycle rest.
entries.new_text: Kill a friendly unit. Look at top 5 cards of Main Deck. You may banish a unit with Might up to 1 more than killed unit and play it, ignoring cost. Then recycle rest.

entries.old_text: Each opponent reveals top card of Main Deck. Choose one and play it, ignoring cost. Then recycle rest.
entries.new_text: Each opponent reveals top card of Main Deck. Choose one and banish it, then play it, ignoring cost. Then recycle rest.

entries.old_text: As you play me, you may pay [C] as additional cost. If you do, draw 1.
entries.new_text: You may pay [C] as additional cost to play me. When you play me, if you paid additional cost, draw 1.

entries.old_text: Choose a friendly unit. Increase its Might until it equals the Might of another friendly unit.
entries.new_text: Choose a friendly unit. This turn, increase its Might to the Might of another friendly unit.

entries.old_text: Reveal cards from top of Main Deck until you reveal a unit. Play it, ignoring cost, and recycle rest.
entries.new_text: Reveal cards from top of Main Deck until you reveal a unit and banish it. Play it, ignoring cost, and recycle rest.

entries.old_text: Deal 3 to a unit at battlefield. If this kills it, draw 1.
entries.new_text: Deal 3 to a unit at battlefield. If this kills it, do this: draw 1.

entries.old_text: Move an enemy unit. Then choose another enemy unit at its destination. They deal damage equal to their Mights to each other.
entries.new_text: Move an enemy unit. Then do this: Choose another enemy unit at its destination. They deal damage equal to their Mights to each other.

entries.old_text: When I attack, give me +2 [M] if there is a ready enemy unit here.
entries.new_text: When I attack, give me +2 [M] this turn if there is a ready enemy unit here.

entries.old_text: Choose a friendly unit. The next time it dies this turn, recall it exhausted instead.
entries.new_text: Choose a friendly unit. The next time it would die this turn, heal it, exhaust it, and recall it instead.

entries.old_text: When you recycle one or more cards, buff a friendly unit.
entries.new_text: When you recycle one or more cards to your Main Deck, buff a friendly unit.

entries.old_text: When you play me, buff two other friendly units.
entries.new_text: When you play me, buff up to two other friendly units.

entries.old_text: When you look at cards from top of deck (and don't draw them) and see me, you may play me for [A].
entries.new_text: As you look at or reveal me from top of deck, you may banish me. If you do, you may play me for [A].

entries.old_text: Return another friendly gear, unit, or [Hidden] card to its owner's hand.
entries.new_text: Return another friendly gear, unit, or facedown card to its owner's hand.

entries.old_text: Banish a friendly unit, then play it to base, ignoring cost.
entries.new_text: Banish a friendly unit, then its owner plays it to their base, ignoring cost.

entries.old_text: Each player looks at top 5 cards of Main Deck, chooses one, then recycles rest. Starting with next player, each player plays those cards, ignoring Energy costs.
entries.new_text: Each player looks at top 5 cards of Main Deck, banishes one of them, then recycles rest. Starting with next player, each player plays those cards, ignoring Energy costs.

entries.old_text: The next spell you play deals 1 Bonus Damage.
entries.new_text: The next spell you play this turn deals 1 Bonus Damage.

entries.old_text: You may kill a gear. Draw 1.
entries.new_text: You may kill up to one gear. Draw 1.

entries.old_text: When you conquer here, recycle one of your runes.
entries.new_text: When you conquer here, you must recycle one of your runes.

entries.old_text: While I'm at a battlefield, ready 4 friendly runes at the end of your turn.
entries.new_text: At the end of your turn, if I'm at a battlefield, ready up to 4 friendly runes.
entries.note: The VEN-SP2 reprint was already printed with the corrected wording -- this is a revision log for the card, not a claim about what's printed on a given physical copy.

entries.old_text: When you conquer here, ready 2 runes at the end of this turn.
entries.new_text: When you conquer here, ready up to 2 runes at the end of this turn.

entries.old_text: When a buffed unit you control would die, you may pay [C] and exhaust me to spend its buff and recall it exhausted instead.
entries.new_text: If a buffed unit you control would die, you may pay [C], exhaust me, and spend its buff to heal it, exhaust it, and recall it instead.

entries.old_text: The first time you choose a friendly unit with a spell here each turn, draw 1.
entries.new_text: When a player chooses a friendly unit here with a spell for the first time each turn, they draw 1.

entries.old_text: Move a friendly unit at a battlefield to your base.
entries.new_text: Move a friendly unit at a battlefield to its base.

entries.old_text: When you play me, you may choose a friendly unit. Move me to its location and it to my original location.
entries.new_text: When you play me, you may choose a unit you control at another location. Move me to its location and it to my original location.

entries.old_text: Move a friendly unit to or from your base.
entries.new_text: Move a friendly unit to or from its base.

entries.old_text: Choose a friendly unit. The next time it dies this turn, you may pay [C] to recall it exhausted instead.
entries.new_text: Choose a friendly unit. The next time it would die this turn, you may pay [C] to heal it, exhaust it, and recall it instead.

entries.old_text: Spells and abilities affecting units here each deal 1 Bonus Damage.
entries.new_text: Spells and abilities deal 1 Bonus Damage to units here.

entries.old_text: The next time a friendly unit would die, kill this instead. Recall that unit exhausted.
entries.new_text: If a friendly unit would die, kill this instead. Heal that unit, exhaust it, and recall it.

entries.old_text: [Hidden] (Hide now for [A] to react with later for [0].) When I defend or I'm played from [Hidden], reveal the top 5 cards of your Main Deck. Deal 1 to an enemy unit here for each card with [Hidden], then recycle them.
entries.new_text: [Hidden] (Hide now for [A] to react with later for [0].) When I defend, choose an enemy unit here and reveal the top 5 cards of your Main Deck. Deal 1 to that unit for each card with [Hidden] revealed this way, then recycle the revealed cards.
entries.note: Mechanical change, not just wording: the 'or I'm played from Hidden' trigger was removed (defend-only now), and damage now requires choosing a single target instead of a looser 'an enemy unit here'. Applied in skill/references/deckbuilding/references/legends/teemo.md, which was re-derived, not just re-quoted.

entries.old_text: At the end of your turn, ready 2 runes.
entries.new_text: At the end of your turn, ready up to 2 runes.
entries.note: This is Annie's Legend ability text (Starter-deck printing). Applied in skill/references/deckbuilding/deckbuilding.md's Annie worked example.

entries.old_text: Do this twice: Deal 3 to a unit. (You can choose different units.)
entries.new_text: Deal 3 to a unit. Deal 3 to a unit.

entries.old_text: Do this 6 times: Deal 2 to a unit. (You can choose different units.)
entries.new_text: Deal 2 to a unit. (repeated six times)

entries.old_text: Look at the top 5 cards of your Main Deck. You may play a unit from among them. Its Energy cost is reduced by [5]. Then recycle the remaining cards.
entries.new_text: Look at the top 5 cards of your Main Deck. You may banish a unit from among them, then play it, reducing its cost by [5]. Recycle the remaining cards.

entries.old_text: Play a 2 [M] Sand Soldier unit token for each Equipment you control. Then ready two of them.
entries.new_text: Play a 2 [M] Sand Soldier unit token for each Equipment you control. Then do this: Ready up to two of them.

entries.old_text: Give a unit [Assault 2]. (+2 [M] while it's an attacker.)
entries.new_text: Give a unit [Assault 2] this turn. (+2 [M] while it's an attacker.)

entries.old_text: Kill a friendly unit to give +[M] equal to its Might to another friendly unit this turn. Draw 1.
entries.new_text: Kill a friendly unit. If you do, give +[M] equal to its Might to another friendly unit this turn. Draw 1.

entries.old_text: When you play this from face down, attach it to a unit you control here.
entries.new_text: When you play this from face down, attach it to a unit you control.

entries.old_text: When you play me, heal your units here, then move an enemy unit from here to its base.
entries.new_text: When you play me, heal your units here, then move up to one enemy unit from here to its base.

entries.old_text: Each Equipment in your hand has [Quick-Draw].
entries.new_text: Your Equipment everywhere have [Quick-Draw].
entries.note: Meaningful expansion, not just wording: the buff used to apply only to Equipment in hand; it now applies everywhere. Relevant if this card is ever cited in a Jax write-up.

entries.old_text: When I move to a battlefield, give a friendly unit my keywords and +[M] equal to my Might this turn.
entries.new_text: When I move to a battlefield, give another friendly unit my keywords and +[M] equal to my Might this turn.

entries.old_text: When I attack, you may reveal the top 2 cards of your Main Deck. You may play one. Then recycle the rest. If the played card is a unit, you may play it here.
entries.new_text: When I attack, you may reveal the top 2 cards of your Main Deck. You may banish one, then play it. If it is a unit, you may play it here. Recycle the rest.
entries.note: Quoted verbatim (pre-errata) in skill/references/deckbuilding/references/legends/reksai.md -- check whether that entry needs the same re-derivation treatment as Teemo's.

entries.old_text: When I attack, you may play an Equipment with Energy cost no more than [2], ignoring its cost, and attach it to me.
entries.new_text: When I attack, you may play an Equipment with Energy cost no more than [2], ignoring its cost. If you do, then do this: Attach it to me.

entries.old_text: While I'm at a battlefield, opponents can't score points.
entries.new_text: While I'm at a battlefield, opponents can't gain points.

entries.old_text: When you conquer, you may exhaust me to reveal the top 2 cards of your Main Deck. You may play one. Then recycle the rest.
entries.new_text: When you conquer, you may exhaust me to reveal the top 2 cards of your Main Deck. You may banish one, then play it. Recycle the rest.

entries.old_text: Reveal the top 2 cards of your Main Deck. You may play one of them, reducing its cost by [2]. Draw any you did not play this way.
entries.new_text: Reveal the top 2 cards of your Main Deck. You may banish one, then play it, reducing its cost by [2]. Draw any you didn't banish.

entries.old_text: When I conquer an open battlefield, deal damage equal to my Might to an enemy unit in a base.
entries.new_text: When I conquer a battlefield that was uncontrolled, deal damage equal to my Might to an enemy unit in a base.

entries.old_text: [Hidden] (...) Play a 2 [M] Sand Soldier unit token. You may pay [C] to ready it.
entries.new_text: [Hidden] (...) Play a 2 [M] Sand Soldier unit token. Then do this: You may pay [C] to ready it.

entries.old_text: [Action] (...) Move a friendly unit. You may attach an Equipment with the same controller to it. This turn, that unit has "When I conquer, you may move me to my base."
entries.new_text: [Action] (...) Move a friendly unit. You may attach up to one Equipment with the same controller to it. This turn, that unit has "When I conquer, you may move me to my base."

entries.old_text: When you conquer or hold, you may discard 1 and exhaust me to play a ready Reflection unit token there. It becomes a copy of another unit there. Give it [Temporary].
entries.new_text: When you conquer or hold, you may discard 1 and exhaust me to play a ready Reflection unit token there. Then do this: It becomes a copy of another unit there. Give it [Temporary].
entries.note: Quoted verbatim (pre-errata) in skill/references/deckbuilding/references/legends/leblanc.md -- wording-only fix, no mechanical change, but should still be re-quoted for accuracy.

entries.old_text: [Hidden] (Hide now for [A] to react with later for [0].) [Temporary] (Kill me at the start of my controller's Beginning Phase, before scoring.) When you play me, play two Reflection unit tokens here. They become copies of me.
entries.new_text: [Hidden] (Hide now for [A] to react with later for [0].) [Temporary] (Kill me at the start of my controller's Beginning Phase, before scoring.) When you play me, play two Reflection unit tokens here. Then do this: They become copies of me.

entries.old_text: Kill a unit at a battlefield. Then, if it had 3 [M] or less, you may play this from your trash for [A].
entries.new_text: Kill a unit at a battlefield. Then, if it had 3 [M] or less, do this: You may play this from your trash for [A].

entries.old_text: [Hidden] (...) Choose a battlefield. An opponent reveals their hand. You may choose a unit from it. They play that unit to that battlefield, ignoring any and all costs. When they do, [Stun] it. (...)
entries.new_text: [Hidden] (...) Choose a battlefield. An opponent reveals their hand. You may choose a unit from it. They play that unit to that battlefield, ignoring any and all costs. If they do, then do this: [Stun] it. (...)

entries.old_text: Choose a unit. Play a ready Reflection unit token to your base. It becomes a copy of that unit. Give it [Temporary]. (...)
entries.new_text: Choose a unit. Play a ready Reflection unit token to your base. Then do this: It becomes a copy of that unit. Give it [Temporary]. (...)
entries.note: This is the same effect shape referenced in skill/references/deckbuilding/references/legends/leblanc.md's description of LeBlanc's own clone token -- wording-only, no mechanical change.

entries.old_text: [Ambush] (You may play me as a [Reaction] to a battlefield where you have units.) I can be played to a battlefield where there are enemy units (even if you don't have units there).
entries.new_text: [Ambush] (You may play me as a [Reaction] to a battlefield where you have units.) I can [Ambush] to a battlefield where there are enemy units, even if you don't have units there.
entries.note: Wording-only, no mechanical change. Applied in skill/references/deckbuilding/references/legends/rengar.md.

entries.old_text: When you play me, you may play a spell from your trash with Energy cost no more than [3], ignoring its Energy cost. Recycle that spell after you play it. (You must still pay its Power cost.)
entries.new_text: When you play me, you may play a spell from your trash with Energy cost no more than [3], ignoring its Energy cost. Then recycle it. (You must still pay its Power cost.)

entries.old_text: When a showdown begins here, you may pay [1]. If you do, [Predict], then reveal the top card of your Main Deck. If it's a spell, draw it. (To Predict, look at the top card of your Main Deck. You may recycle it.)
entries.new_text: When a showdown begins here, you may pay [1] to [Predict], then reveal the top card of your Main Deck. If it's a spell, draw it. (To Predict, look at the top card of your Main Deck. You may recycle it.)
entries.note: Quoted verbatim (pre-errata) in skill/references/deckbuilding/references/legends/diana.md -- wording-only fix, no mechanical change, but should still be re-quoted for accuracy.

entries.old_text: When I win a combat, play a Gold gear token exhausted. When I attack or defend, you may pay [C]. If you do, give me +2 [M] this turn.
entries.new_text: When I win a combat, play a Gold gear token exhausted. When I attack or defend, you may pay [C] to give me +2 [M] this turn.
entries.note: Wording-only, no mechanical change. Applied in skill/references/deckbuilding/references/legends/draven.md.

entries.old_text: When you conquer here, you may pay [1] and return a unit you control here to its owner's hand. If you do, play a 2 [M] Sand Soldier unit token here.
entries.new_text: When you conquer here, you may pay [1] and return a unit you control here to its owner's hand to play a 2 [M] Sand Soldier unit token here.

entries.old_text: [Ambush] (...) As an additional cost to play me, kill a Bird, Cat, Dog, or Poro you control. You may play me to its battlefield (even if you don't have other units there).
entries.new_text: [Ambush] (...) As an additional cost to play me, kill a Bird, Cat, Dog, or Poro you control. You may [Ambush] me to its battlefield, even if you don't have other units there.

entries.old_text: When you play your first card each turn, if I'm at a battlefield, your next card costs [2][A][A] less.
entries.new_text: When you play your first card each turn, if I'm at a battlefield, the next card you play this turn costs [2][A][A] less.

entries.old_text: [Empower] [C][C] (...) [Empowered][>] If a spell or ability that chooses me would stun me, give me -[M], or return me to hand, give me +3 [M] instead.
entries.new_text: [Empower] [C][C] (...) [Empowered][>] If a spell or ability that chooses me would stun me, give me -[M], or return me to hand, give me +3 [M] this turn instead.

entries.old_text: [Hidden] (Hide now for [A] to react with later for [0].) [Reaction] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.) Choose a battlefield you control and a unit you control at a different location. Move that unit to that battlefield and give it +2 [S] this turn.
entries.new_text: [Hidden] (Hide now for [A] to react with later for [0].) [Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.) Choose a battlefield you control and a unit you control at a different location. Move that unit to that battlefield and give it +2 [S] this turn.
